## Portfolio

- Nomenclature Approval Flow — UML sequence diagram

- Access Request & Approval — BPMN 2.0

- System Architecture — UML component diagram of a multi-tenant records platform

- Spec & Story Validator — BPMN 2.0 process of a local LLM assistant that checks a spec or a user story against eight standards and golden stories and returns an audit, recommendations and suggested edits; the analyst decides
